text: [link: Sat & Sun screening, 6:30pm, Rangoli Arts Cafe]
Ooh is that the one with the director q&a
Yes sunday one has the q&a
Sunday works. Sat I might have a client call thing
What's it about
A fishing village thing. Ratings say slow but beautiful. The trailer had a LOT of sea
Ok sunday might work. Depends if I get off on time
Reading this from the back of the shop lol. Sunday evening I'm free I think, will check roster
Is it at the cafe with the bad aircon
The very same
[photo: screenshot of edit timeline]
Client wants it "more warm". What does that mean
More orange?
Ya that's what I'd guess too
Can't sleep. Have to be at the food drive by 8 so I'll be dead lol
Just got home. Closing count took forever
[photo: stacked rice sacks outside the community hall]
They gave us the wrong count of dal packets again
Client says warm = less blue in the shadows. Not orange lol
Fixed it. They said "perfect" which I don't believe
Roster's out. Sunday I'm on till 4 then off
So 6:30 works if they don't pull me into closing
Just woke up. Is the q&a a real q&a or just the director saying thanks
Real q&a. Like 20 min I think
Ok then. I'll come if I can get off by 5
Back from the drive. Legs gone
Does the cafe still do the filter coffee or did they change it
They changed it. New one is mid
Still better than the aircon
Mgr put me on sunday 2 to close. Might not make 6:30
Oh no. Come after if you can
Q&a will probably run late anyway
[photo: my desk, 3 monitors and a cup of cold chai]
Dont ask
Sleep
Will try. Will text tmrw if I'm off
Sunday morning. Nothing to do for once
Does the cafe take card or cash only
Card works now. They put a machine in
Ok good
Off. Going home to shower, I smell like samosa oil
Lol
Still on. Manager keeps saying 5 min
Don't think I'll get out by 5
Ok. Don't stress. Text when you know
[photo: colour graded frame, before and after side by side]
Left is what I had. Right is "warm"
Right looks like someone's grandma's wall
That's the vibe apparently
Off at 6. Might come for the last bit if the q&a is still going
Q&A is 20 min. Start is 6:30 so maybe later. See you if you can make it
Leaving the house now
Home. It was good. The fishing scenes are so quiet
Director was nice. Talked about shooting in winter for 6 months
Was the aircon on
No. They turned it off. We froze
Sat at the back. Client called during the boat scene lol
Got there at the end. Was the boat scene the one with the goat
No goat. Just a lot of sea
[photo: blurry poster on a cafe table]
Ask the cafe guy about the filter coffee lol
Should we do this again next month? Cafe is terrible but the films are good
Ya sure. Sat works better for me
Sat I'm on till 9 sorry
I'll look at it tmrw. Too tired
Ok. Night
